messages:
jamal: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to finalize who sends the external summary and when. The customer-facing ask is: a short incident summary on the status page + a link to the RCA within 72 hours. Thoughts?
sara: Agree. 72 hours is OK for an initial summary, not the full technical RCA. We should be explicit about "initial summary" vs "full RCA". :+1:
alex: For Dedicated customers we promised more detail and timelines. Can we standardize: initial status page update within 4 hours, follow-up summary within 72 hours, full RCA within 14 days unless blocked by investigation?
maria: That matches expectations. For regulatory customers we might need different timelines, call those out in exportable template.
jamal: Sounds good. Who volunteers to own the 72-hour summary and link placement on status page? @sara?
sara: I can draft the 72-hour summary for public incidents and post the status page update. I might need a technical blurb from eng — @alex can you provide a 2-3 sentence root cause and mitigation that I can paste?
alex: Yep. I'll drop a short blurb into the thread within 2 hours.
statusbot: [deploy] Status page post queued: "Initial summary draft by sara" — ETA 30m.
maria: Two process notes: 1) We must log the follow-up action item in the postmortem tracker with owner + ETA. 2) If the RCA will be delayed past 14 days, escalate to CTL for approval and communicate updated timeline externally.
jamal: Agreed. Let's create concrete action items here so we don't lose them.
- jamal: create external summary template and checklist — owner: jamal — due: 2026-03-27 EOD
- sara: post initial 72h summary to status page and include link to follow-up doc — owner: sara — due: 2026-03-26 16:00 UTC
- alex: provide 2-3 sentence technical root cause + mitigation for status copy — owner: alex — due: 2 hours from now
- maria: confirm if any affected customers have regulatory constraints and list them — owner: maria — due: 2026-03-26 18:00 UTC
sara: Draft initial status page copy (will finalize after alex's blurb):
```
Incident: Intermittent inference failures affecting Hosted API (us-west)
Summary: We experienced intermittent errors for requests routed to a subset of hosts, causing elevated 5xx rates and increased latencies for some customers. Traffic was rerouted and recovery actions were applied; customers may have seen errors between 11:02–11:28 UTC. We will publish a full RCA once our investigation completes.
Impact: Elevated 5xx rates and latencies for clients in the us-west region.
Next steps: A 72-hour follow-up with preliminary findings and links to remediation actions will be posted; a full RCA will follow within 14 days.
```
alex: + minor tweak: replace "subset of hosts" with "a misconfigured routing table on a dedicated inference pool". Also add mitigation line: "We rolled back the routing change and increased probe frequency to prevent recurrence."
sara: Updated. I'll post once jamal confirms the action items.
jamal: Confirmed. A couple more protocol items we should add to the comms playbook:
- Always label the post as "Initial summary" (so customers know it's preliminary)
- Include expected timeline for RCA and a link to a tracker doc if available
- For Dedicated or regulatory customers, include a note about how they will receive direct comms (account team vs. status page)
sara: I'll add those to the template. Also recommending we keep the status page summary <= 6 short lines, and link to a separate post with more context to avoid clutter.
maria: On recurring incident patterns — ops noted similar routing misconfig events 3x this quarter. We should include a recurring-incident flag in the RCA and route for a deeper remediation (change control + safer defaults). I'll open the remediation ticket after the RCA is public.
jamal: Good. Add that remediation ticket as a follow-up action item in the postmortem tracker and assign to eng-platform with a 30-day ETA.
alex: Happy to own the engineering remediation proposal (draft due in 14 days). I'll link it from the RCA.
statusbot: [post] Status update published: "Initial summary: Intermittent inference failures (us-west)" — https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1766123456
sara: Posted and sent to customer success for targeted outreach to impacted accounts. :mailbox_with_mail:
jamal: Thanks team. I'll update the postmortem tracker now with the actions we listed and close this thread. If anyone needs edits to the status copy ping me.
maria: One last ask — let's add an explicit line in the comms policy: "RCA distribution: public RCAs are posted to the status site and linked from support tickets; customers requesting full raw logs or internal timelines get a limited export under NDA/contract review." I can draft that language.
maria: filing that as action: write RCA distribution policy — owner: maria — due: 2026-04-02
jamal: Excellent. Thread closed for now. :white_check_mark:
